transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

I... well, I suppose I'm here because of my in-laws. It's not just regular family arguing anymore. I know what they're doing. They've been... using the altar, and the parish committee. Just trying to push me out. Trying to make everyone forget everything I've done for this family.

When you say your in-laws are trying to push you out and make everyone forget what you've done, do you feel this is because they truly intend to harm you, or is there more to it — like they're part of a larger plan or influence?

I... I think I just said that. It's them. They're the ones using the altar. And the committee. I don't know about some... larger plan. I just know what they're doing. They want to push me out and make sure everyone forgets me. I don't really want to keep explaining it.
Do you feel that your in-laws' actions are specifically targeted at you because of something unique or special about you, something that others might not understand?

Well... yes. I mean, I'm the only one who actually understands how to save our family's traditions. If they would just listen to me, the whole community event would be perfect. But they don't want that. They just want me out of the way.
Do you ever feel like you're the only one who truly understands the bigger picture, even when others don't agree with you?

I... yes. I mean, I already told you that. I'm the only one who gets it. The traditions, the community event... it would all be perfect if they just let me handle it. But they won't listen. I don't really have anything else to say about it.
Do you feel that people in general are often trying to harm you or take advantage of you, even when there's no clear reason for it?
No... not everybody. I don't know why strangers would care. It's just them... my in-laws. Like I said. I don't really pay attention to other people.
Do you believe your in-laws are doing things that are not based in reality, like using the altar in ways others wouldn't notice or understand?

I... well, yes. That's... that's why I came in here, really. I just knew they weren't just arguing with me anymore. They were... they were using the altar. And the parish committee. They're using all of it to push me out. They want everyone to forget what I've done for this family.
When you say your in-laws are using the altar, do you mean in a symbolic or religious way, or are they using it in a supernatural or magical way to affect you?

I... I don't know about magic. I just know they're using it against me. The altar, the committee... they're just using it all to push me out. To make everyone forget what I've done for this family. I don't know how else to explain it.

I... I feel like I just said this. I don't know what other people notice. I just know it's not... it's not just normal arguing anymore. They are using the altar. And the committee. I... I don't know about magic. I just know what I already told you. They aren't just arguing. They're using the altar... and the committee... to push me out. To make everyone forget me and what I've done. That's why I came in. I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing.

I... I don't know about special powers. I've already told you why I came in. They aren't just arguing with me anymore.
